TABLE.NAME: mybrainchat
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the mybrainchat activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: brainid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Quivr Brain ID used for this activity.

FIELD.NAME: apikey
FIELD.COMMENT: The API key used to access the Quivr brain.

FIELD.NAME: use_for_popup
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this instance should be used for the course popup chat.
